tool.name: DICOM series to OHIF JSON
tool.description: Index a DICOM series for OHIF without DICOMweb (Galaxy serves the files)
tool.help:
Writes an OHIF "DICOM JSON" index (studies / series / instances with naturalized headers) whose instance URLs point at this Galaxy server's dataset file API (``/api/datasets/<id>/display?filename=<file>``). Open it in OHIF with
``/ohif/viewer/dicomjson?url=<galaxy>/api/datasets/<this output id>/display``
The SMIS Browser visualization does this for you. No DICOMweb server is involved; pixels are fetched from Galaxy through the SMIS gateway with the user's session.
